paper.title_en: Precise Determination of Pomeron Intercept via Scaling Entropy
paper.abstract_en: We present the concept of scaling entropy as a quantitative tool to study particle production in high-energy collisions. This observable connects experimental hadron multiplicity data with the underlying partonic dynamics at the initial state. We apply the concept to both deep inelastic scattering (DIS) and proton-proton collisions, using data from HERA, CMS, and ATLAS. We extract the entropy growth rate λ and show its consistency across different collision systems, highlighting the potential of scaling entropy for future applications in heavy-ion collisions and electron-ion colliders.
